title: Pokanoket Tribal lands
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The Pokanoket Tribe of the Pokanoket Nation proudly announces the reclamation of Potumtuk, a sacred portion of our ancestral Sowams homeland. This land holds deep significance, as it was home to Massasoit, the great Pokanoket sachem whose alliance with the Pilgrims shaped the narrative of the First Thanksgiving.
